quiz.q1: Looking up an arrival time alone is not an explicitly asked booklet type.
quiz.q2: Option 1's explanation must identify subtracting the whole HHMM entries as ordinary integers. Subtracting the displayed minute components gives 30 − 40 = −10, not 90.
quiz.q3: Identifying a service from an exact arrival time alone is not an explicitly asked booklet type.
quiz.q4: Converting a timetable entry to 12-hour notation alone is not asked in the supplied timetable exercises.
quiz.q5: Recognising which trips cross midnight is not an explicitly asked booklet type; the booklet asks for calculated times and durations across midnight.
quiz.q6: Selecting the shortest journey is not explicitly asked in the booklet.

theory: The unconditional instruction to read down a column for one trip and across a row for one stop needs to be qualified by the table headings. Candidate tables also place sessions in rows and Start/Finish in columns, so the stated orientation does not consistently apply.
summary: Replaced unsupported tasks with adapted booklet questions using new values, restricted the midnight practice item to calculating duration, and corrected quiz q2's distractor explanation while preserving the supported items and all quiz ids. Qualified the theory's table orientation and updated its reading steps; no whole items were removed.
reviewSummary: All 19 requested items have correct answers and use booklet question types, including harder journey-duration values across midnight. The theory and supplied working are usable, and every quiz has exactly one correct option with accurate distractor explanations.
